M8/#624, JUDGE W DOUGLASS, CSR R BARULICH, CLK H HAMILTON CASE CALLED FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE AT 1400. MARC SEIDENFELD FOR PLAINTIFF EVELYN CRANE, WHO IS PRESENT, SARGE HOLTZMAN FOR DEFENDANT AMY SCHOENBORN, WHO IS PRESENT. CASE SETTLED, AS FOLLOWS: STIPULATION FOR JUDGMENT FOR PLAINTIFF AND AGAINST DEFENDANT FOR POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES AT 3278 21ST ST. #B, S.F. AND $750. IN RENT & DAMAGES. WRIT MAY ISSUE BY 5PM 6-1-98. DEFENDANT TO PAY $750. TO PLAINTIFF BY 3-26-98 5PM, PLAINTIFF WAIVES ALL OTHER RENT AND DAMAGES. IF NOT PAID TIMELY, STAY WILL BE LIFTED. DEFENDANT WAIVES RETURN, ACCOUNTING, AND INTEREST ON SECURITY DEPOSIT. PLAINTIFF WILL GIVE NEUTRAL REFERENCE. PROPERTY LEFT ON PREMISES AFTER 5PM ON 6-1-98 WILL BE DEEMED ABANDONED. DEFENDANT ACKNOWLEDGES DINING ROOM SET IS PLAINTIFF'S. LEASE FORFEITED. EACH SIDE BEAR OWN COSTS & FEES. PLAINTIFF WILL SET ASIDE JUDGMENT AND DISMISS WITH PREJUDICE AFTER COMPLIANCE. PLAINTIFF TO PREPARE JUDGMENT.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SCHOENBORN, AMY THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 3278 - 21ST STREET, #B, S.F, STAYED UNTIL JUN-01-1998, LEASE FORFEITED, DINING ROOM SET IS PLAINTIFF'S, SEE JUDGMENT FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS
